summary: This is an MMDetection3D configuration file (no callable functions/classes). It inherits from centerpoint_0075voxel_second_secfpn_4x8_cyclic_20e_nus.py and overrides the bounding box head to use DCNSeperateHead with deformable convolutions and sets circle NMS for testing.
note: This file contains only configuration dictionaries and variables — no callable functions, classes, or CLI entry points. No example tool statements are applicable.

config_overrides.seperate_head: DCNSeperateHead with DCN (in_channels=64, out_channels=64, kernel_size=3, padding=1, groups=4, init_bias=-2.19, final_kernel=3)
config_overrides.test_nms: circle NMS type for 3D point cloud bounding box post-processing

inheritance_chain: centerpoint_0075voxel_second_secfpn_dcn_circlenms_4x8_cyclic_20e_nus.py (this file — adds DCN head + circle NMS)
centerpoint_0075voxel_second_secfpn_4x8_cyclic_20e_nus.py (parent — sets 0.075 voxel size, 108m x 108m point cloud range, data pipelines)
centerpoint_01voxel_second_secfpn_4x8_cyclic_20e_nus.py (grandparent — sets 102.4m range, DB sampler, train/test pipelines, data loaders)
use_cases: Configure CenterPoint 3D object detection with deformable convolution (DCN) in the separate head for nuScenes dataset
Use circle NMS instead of standard NMS for 3D bounding box post-processing during inference
Fine-tune voxel-based 3D detection with finer 0.075m voxel resolution and DCN-enhanced head
Override the default SECONDFPN head with a DCNSeperateHead variant for improved feature aggregation
Set up a CenterPoint model configuration for 10-class nuScenes detection (car, truck, bus, pedestrian, etc.)
